meta.title: About Taskote
meta.description: Taskote is a local services marketplace connecting customers and skilled professionals across Kerala.

hero.title: About Taskote
hero.lead: Taskote is a local services marketplace helping customers explore listed categories for homes, shops, offices and commercial establishments, and helping skilled professionals connect with local service requests. For our public launch, enquiries are handled directly via WhatsApp Business.
hero.caption: Connecting customers with local skills

mission.title: Mission
mission.lead: To make local service categories straightforward to explore and help customers find reliable, skilled assistance across Kerala.

vision.title: Vision
vision.lead: To connect Kerala communities with trusted local professionals for homes, shops, offices and commercial establishments through accessible, direct channels.

items.title: Trust
items.desc: Clear information about services and honest communication.

items.title: People first
items.desc: Built around the practical needs of customers and skilled workers.

items.title: Reliability
items.desc: Respect for people’s time, clear expectations, and quality work.

items.title: Community
items.desc: Supporting local skills and independent livelihoods across Kerala.

customers.title: How Taskote helps customers
items: Discover which skilled professionals can handle your job
Understand exactly what each service covers with clear scopes
Fast, direct enquiries via WhatsApp Business
Personal assistance from the Taskote support team

professionals.title: How Taskote helps professionals
items: Register your trade and service coverage areas
Receive direct enquiries from nearby customers
Quick WhatsApp registration with no complicated initial setup
Build your local reputation and customer base

bottomCta.title: Be part of Taskote
bottomCta.text: Enquire about a service as a customer, or register as a skilled professional.
